title: After Google sign-in the browser lands on the publication root instead of the newsroom when only the root redirect URL is registered for a host
description:
Ryan, 2026-10-09: signed in at https://threat-intelligence.anth.us (Pretext site; reader at `/`, newsroom at `/newsroom`) and landed on the publication (`/` -> /2026/july/04), not the newsroom. /newsroom worked when navigated to.

Cause: Amplify sign-in uses `redirect_sign_in_uri` chosen by `prioritizeCurrentOrigin` in components/amplify-client-provider.tsx. The TI scaffold lists only `https://threat-intelligence.anth.us/` and the staging equivalent (no `/newsroom` variant); only the default Amplify host got both variants.

Fix at template/package layer: in amplify/auth/resource.ts and infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/site-config.ts, expand every configured origin to `<origin>/newsroom` first and `<origin>/`, honoring newsroomBasePath, with tests and docs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-09T17:17Z: Fix in PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/171 (branch feature/PPY-8b0477-newsroom-redirect-urls). Root cause confirmed: Amplify signs in with the first redirect_sign_in_uri entry for the current origin (prioritizeCurrentOrigin in components/amplify-client-provider.tsx); the TI scaffold lists only root URLs for real hosts. defineSiteAuth now expands every origin to /newsroom then / (root only when the brand newsroomBasePath is empty); template validation accepts bare origins. ts job green; python and smoke jobs red for a reason unrelated to this change (develop itself is red since #168: ModuleNotFoundError decision_flywheel and the non-registry Cyclotron git requirement in the wheel, and the Release run fails), so NOT merged and no release published yet. Blocked on develop being fixed.

right_now_summary: A fix is in PR 171, but unrelated develop failures are delaying its merge and release.
